components.name: Lock Action
components.description: Primary action for locking a move or starting a match.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 15px; height: 39px; min-width: 172px; padding: 0 12px 0 16px; border: 1px solid #85d176; border-radius: 7px; background: #85d176; color: #0d2d46; font: 600 11px 'Manrope', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px #85d17644; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a3e190; box-shadow: 0 5px 16px #85d17666; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #85d176; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #70bd62; }

components.name: Room Action
components.description: Secondary room creation, join, and utility action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #789274; border-radius: 7px; background: #f7fbe9; color: #0d2d46; font: 500 9px 'Manrope', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .18s, color .18s, background .18s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #477d3e; color: #285d2e; background: #e7f6dd; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #85d176; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #dff2d4; }

components.name: Room Code Field
components.description: Monospaced room code entry paired with a join action.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-room" aria-label="Room code" placeholder="ROOM CODE" maxlength="5" />
components.css: .ds-input-room { width: 100%; height: 34px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #91a98a; border-radius: 7px 0 0 7px; background: #fffdf0; color: #0d2d46; caret-color: #3f5ba4; font: 10px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 1px; } .ds-input-room::placeholder { color: #536d77; opacity: 1; } .ds-input-room:focus { border-color: #3f5ba4; outline: none; } .ds-input-room:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #85d176; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Working Rail
components.description: Pale working surface for roster, loadout, or settings content.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 15px; border: 1px solid #c1d5b7; border-radius: 12px; background: #e6fbda; color: #0d2d46; font-family: 'Manrope', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-rail-label { color: #405976; font: 9px 'DM Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 1.4px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail-value { font: 700 30px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; }

components.name: Utility Navigation Control
components.description: Compact outlined utility action in the dark top bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-control { width: 31px; height: 31px; border: 1px solid #55758a; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #e6fbda; font: 15px 'Manrope', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-nav-control:hover, .ds-nav-control[aria-current='page'] { border-color: #85d176; color: #85d176; background: #163b53; } .ds-nav-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #85d176; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Kala’s interface pairs a deep-space broadcast shell with light, practical work surfaces. The dark arena and frame hold the match in focus; pale mint and lemon rails keep roster, loadout, and controls readable. The visual voice is ‘Fresh, light field-guide colors; calm, precise controls.’

Display type gives match headlines and player names a condensed, high-energy voice. Manrope keeps body copy and controls fresh and readable; DM Mono is reserved for phase labels, room codes, readouts, and other measured interface data. The game keeps planned positions private until commitment, and the read-only TV view preserves that privacy. A lemon marker tracing the moss safe-zone contour once after each resolved volley makes the arena’s change legible.
keyCharacteristics: Deep Space shell with light mint and lemon working rails
Condensed display typography paired with monospaced data labels
Clear separation between hidden planning and revealed resolution
A single contour-tracing pulse at safe-zone transitions

rules.name: The Semantic Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral is reserved for Red team identity and critical hit or danger states; it is not a general accent.

rules.name: The Light-Rail Contrast Rule
rules.body: Dusk Blue belongs on light surfaces for secondary content. Keep dark-surface text and critical state colors distinct and readable.

rules.name: The Role Pairing Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for display, Manrope for body/UI and controls, and DM Mono only for measured/interface data such as phase labels, room codes, and readouts.

rules.name: The Tonal-Zone Rule
rules.body: Use surface contrast and borders to organize the rails; reserve stronger shadow for overlays and the central arena.

dos: Do keep the shell and arena grounded in Deep Space Blue while using the pale rails as readable working surfaces.
Do use Moss Green for safe, ready, confirmed, and focused states.
Do keep phase labels, room codes, and measured values in DM Mono.
Do preserve hidden positions through planning and reveal only after all living players lock.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences for the contour pulse.
donts: Don't use coral as a general-purpose accent; reserve it for Red team and critical/danger semantics.
Don't place Dusk Blue text on dark grounds where the contrast is weak.
Don't use the contour pulse to expose planned positions or aim lines.
Don't replace the three-part desktop hierarchy with an equal-weight grid.
